title: Computer Operator
description:
About the Role

MobiFit is seeking a detail\-oriented and highly organized Inventory \& Stock Executive to manage our mobile parts inventory, because mobile repair requires tracking hundreds of small model\-specific components (screens, batteries, IC chips, flex, cables), accurate stock management is the backbone of our business. In this role, you will take full ownership of tracking, updating, and reconciling our physical inventory using Microsoft Excel, ensuring we never run out of critical parts.

Key Responsibilities

Excel Database Management: Maintain and continuously update the master inventory spreadsheet tracking all mobile parts, tools, and accessories.

Inward/Outward Tracking: Accurately log all daily incoming shipments from suppliers and outward dispatch/sales to customers or repair technicians.

Reorder Management: Monitor stock levels and use Excel (formulas/conditional formatting) to identify and flag low\-stock items for immediate reordering.

SKU \& Variation Management: Organize parts logically by brand, model, and component type (e.g., separating Apple, Samsung, and Xiaomi LCDs, batteries, and charging ports).

Reconciliation \& Auditing: Conduct weekly and monthly physical stock counts to verify that the physical parts on the shelves match the data in the Excel sheets. Investigate and resolve any discrepancies.

Reporting: Generate daily and weekly summary reports on stock movement, fast\-moving items, and dead/aging stock for store management.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

Excel Proficiency: Strong hands\-on experience with MS Excel. Must be comfortable using basic to intermediate functions (e.g., SUM, VLOOKUP, COUNTIF, filtering, sorting, and conditional formatting) to manage large datasets.

Attention to Detail: Absolute precision in data entry. A single digit mistake can confuse an iPhone 13 Pro Max screen with an iPhone 13 Pro screen.

Inventory Experience: Prior experience in inventory management, data entry, or stock\-keeping is highly preferred.

Industry Knowledge: Basic familiarity with mobile phone brands, models, and internal repair parts is a significant advantage, though on\-the\-job training can be provided.

Organizational Skills: Ability to keep both digital records and physical workspaces clean, structured, and easy to navigate.

Reliability: Trustworthy and accountable, with a proactive approach to solving inventory discrepancies.

What We Offer

Competitive salary of 15k\-25k

Employee discounts on parts/repairs.

A stable, fast\-paced work environment with a supportive team.

Standard working hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Monday \- Saturday

How to Apply

Please send your resume and a brief outline of your experience using Excel for data management to mymobifit@gmai.com or drop it off in person at MobiFit near metro pillar 846 Rohtak road Bahadurgarh.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Food and Beverages Executive
description:

We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Essential Skills

Drive service excellence, food quality, hygiene, and customer satisfaction initiatives.
  
Monitor vendor performance against SLAs, KPIs, and contractual commitments.
  
Conduct regular audits of cafeteria operations, food safety standards, and facility readiness.

Drive corrective action plans arising from audits, leadership feedback, and customer concerns.

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Business Development Manager- Field Sales
description:
**ABOUT MARKETING \& SALES DEPARTMENT**


The Marketing \& Sales division at DHL Global Forwarding serves as a crucial link between clients and various operational and product departments. Its primary objectives include acquiring new business opportunities while also ensuring the retention of existing clientele.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**


As the Business Development Manager, you will spearhead the expansion of the business by identifying and capitalizing on opportunities from both potential clients and our existing customer base. Beyond conventional sales, your role extends to creating SOPs, fostering inter\-departmental collaboration, and harnessing the power of Sales360\. Your key focus lies in comprehensively grasping customer requirements and harnessing DGF's freight forwarding proficiency to provide personalized solutions.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Sales Cycle Management**


* Lead the entire sales process from lead generation to successful conversion.
* Facilitate seamless payment processes to ensure timely closure of deals.
* Conduct regular reviews to monitor business performance and adjust strategies as necessary.
* Develop and manage a robust sales pipeline to achieve individual and team targets for profitable volume growth.
* Utilize DHL’s Sales360 application to enhance sales efficiency.

  

**Customer Relationship Management**


* Gain insights into customers' core requirements and offer tailored solutions to drive profitable business relationships.
* Proactively address service issues and resolve them in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with existing clients to increase their share of wallet through value\-based selling.
* Identify and onboard new clients that align with our service offerings and values.
* Managing internal and external stakeholders to aid in the development of products and solutions that align with market demands.
* Collaborate with colleagues from product and customer service divisions to meet customer expectations effectively.
* Gain insights into customer requirements and propose tailored solutions to address their needs.

  

**COMPETENCIES**


**Functional Competencies**


* Building Sales Pipeline: Efficiently managing the sales pipeline from lead generation to closure, ensuring timely follow\-ups and conversions.
* Product Knowledge: Deep understanding of products like Air and Ocean, enabling effective communication of value propositions to clients.
* Sales Tools Utilization: Utilizing Sales360 tool effectively to track sales activities, manage customer relationships, and enhance productivity.
* Customer Focus: Dedication to understanding customer needs and delivering tailored solutions that exceed expectations.

  

**Behavioural Competencies**


* Resilience: Ability to handle rejection, setbacks, and pressure inherent in sales roles, maintaining a positive attitude and determination.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high\-quality results and services.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**


**Must Have**


* Bachelor's degree is required.
* 5\-6 years of hands\-on experience in sales roles, preferably within the freight forwarding, shipping, or logistics sectors.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to convey ideas, negotiate deals, and address concerns effectively.

**Preferred**


* Post\-graduate degree with a focus on sales/marketing.
* Experience of working at a multinational freight forwarding company.

title: Business Development Manager, Monetization
description:
Meta is seeking a Business Development Manager to drive monetization strategy and partnership development in the key India market. In this role, you will define and execute high\-impact commercial frameworks that expand Meta's revenue ecosystem across advertising, commerce, and emerging monetization surfaces. You will identify, structure, and close transformative partnerships that unlock new revenue streams, shape product monetization strategy, and influence how Meta's platforms generate sustainable value at scale. This is a role for a experienced business development leader who can operate with full autonomy across complex, ambiguous deal environments and drive company\-level outcomes.  

  

  

### **Business Development Manager, Monetization Responsibilities:**

* Define and lead the long\-term monetization partnership strategy across Meta's advertising, commerce, and platform revenue surfaces
* Identify, evaluate, and execute high\-value strategic partnerships that unlock new monetization opportunities or expand existing revenue streams
* Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements, including revenue\-sharing arrangements, API monetization deals, and platform licensing frameworks
* Collaborate with product, engineering, legal, and finance teams to align partnership structures with Meta's monetization product roadmap
* Develop and own executive\-level business cases and investment theses for new monetization initiatives, presenting to senior leadership
* Establish frameworks for evaluating partnership ROI, deal economics, and long\-term revenue impact across Meta's monetization portfolio
* Serve as the primary external relationship owner for strategic monetization partners, managing C\-suite and senior stakeholder engagement
* Anticipate market shifts in digital advertising, commerce, and platform monetization to proactively shape Meta's partnership positioning
* Provide strategic guidance to cross\-functional teams on monetization deal structures, market dynamics, and competitive landscape
* Drive organizational alignment on monetization partnership priorities, influencing roadmap decisions and resource allocation across business units

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 12\+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or corporate development with a focus on monetization, advertising, or platform revenue
* Experience structuring and closing complex, multi\-party commercial agreements including revenue\-sharing, licensing, or platform monetization deals
* Track record of defining and executing partnership strategies that have generated measurable, large\-scale revenue impact
* Experience engaging and influencing C\-suite and senior executive stakeholders at partner organizations
* Experience operating independently in ambiguous, high\-stakes deal environments with accountability for company\-level outcomes

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience building and scaling business development functions or establishing new partnership categories from the ground up
* Background in commerce, payments, or emerging platform monetization surfaces such as messaging, AI\-driven experiences, or wearables
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in digital advertising ecosystem partnerships, including programmatic, performance marketing, or ad tech monetization models
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex deal structures into clear financial models and executive\-ready strategic narratives
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

  

  

  

  

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Sales Operations & AI Business Intelligence Manager
description:
**SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

***SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.***
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 **Who We Are**


At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best in class mobile and IoT device management solutions. We are looking for out of the box thinkers that appreciate the art of creating great software.


To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they’ve always been done.


What We’re Looking For


SOTI’s growth and success is a result of commitment to innovation through entrepreneurial culture and leadership. We’re looking for a Sales Operations \& AI Business Intelligence Manager who wants to do three things at once: run the operating engine behind a global sales organization, lead and grow a team of business analysts and operations professionals, and act as SOTI’s subject matter expert for AI\-driven reporting.


This is an outstanding opportunity to decide how a global sales organization sees itself. You will own the numbers our sales leaders run the business on, the team that produces them, and the shift from manual reporting toward AI\-assisted, self\-serve intelligence. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment, enjoy working with emerging technologies, and want your fingerprints on how a market leader sells, this role puts you at the centre of it.

**What’s in it for you?**


The People – From our humble origins in our founder’s basement, to our industry leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation and fun.


The Growth – Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast\-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big!


The Technology – You’ll get the chance to work with leading edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects, as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners, which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies.


What you will do


Run the local sales operations engine

* Support execution of annual and quarterly business planning with India regional sales leaders, keeping the focus on plan execution and the ability to get to quarterly targets.
* Own forecast reporting, variance analysis, funnel reviews and top opportunity analysis for sales leaders, and drive accurate forecasting through sales process best practice, pipeline management and opportunity hygiene.
* Identify risk in the forecast, build mitigation plans and hold regional teams accountable to delivering their quarterly numbers.
* Provide analysis across pricing and deal structure trends, revenue streams and product sets to advise on future go\-to\-market initiatives, and act as a point on non\-standard deal structuring requests.
* Maintain a single, defensible set of definitions for pipeline, bookings, coverage, conversion and forecast accuracy, and hold the organization to them.
* Drive continual improvement of sales tools and process to streamline the sales cycle, and execute effective change management across the organization when process, systems or tools change.

**Lead and grow the India Data, Analytics, Reporting team**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of business analysts and sales operations professionals, setting clear standards for analytical rigour and delivery.
* Run a consistent people cadence: regular one\-on\-ones, documented goals, mid\-year and annual reviews, and honest, timely feedback.
* Plan capacity and assign work across competing priorities, protecting the team from thrash while keeping commitments to stakeholders.
* Build the team’s AI and analytics capability deliberately, through training, pairing and hands\-on projects, so that expertise is never concentrated in one person.
* Own team decisions and be accountable for team outcomes, including hiring, onboarding and retention of key talent.

**Lead AI reporting and business intelligence**

* Act as SOTI’s internal subject matter expert for AI\-driven business intelligence — evaluating platforms and capabilities, and making clear build, buy or defer recommendations.
* Own the reporting and dashboard roadmap, from source data in Salesforce and connected systems through to semantic models, dashboards and self\-serve analytics.
* Apply machine learning and generative AI where they demonstrably improve outcomes: forecast accuracy, pipeline risk detection, renewal and expansion signals, and narrative reporting.
* Ensure data integrity, accuracy and compliance across Salesforce and integrated systems, and participate in user acceptance testing to validate system changes.
* Drive adoption through enablement sessions and clear usage guidance, and measure whether the tools are genuinely changing how decisions get made.
* Establish guardrails for data quality, access, privacy and responsible AI use in partnership with IT and Security, and document how automated outputs are validated.

**Partner across the business**

* Facilitate stakeholder sessions to gather requirements, align expectations and drive consensus across functions with competing priorities.
* Lead complex projects from inception to closure, managing scope, timelines, dependencies, risk and deliverables.
* Work with sales enablement to train and onboard new sales team members on process, tooling and reporting.
* Translate between technical and non\-technical audiences, presenting the same insight credibly to a data engineer and to a regional sales leader.

**Experience you will bring**

* MBA from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school.
* 8\+ years of post\-MBA experience across sales, revenue or business operations within a high\-growth technology organisation; enterprise SaaS experience is a distinct advantage.
* Proven track record of leading teams of analysts or consultants, with direct people management accountability rather than project\-only leadership.
* Demonstrated depth in business intelligence, including hands\-on experience taking AI, machine learning or advanced analytics capabilities into production use — not only evaluating them.
* Strong business, commercial and financial acumen, with a proven ability to develop structured business plans, craft KPIs and implement metrics to manage sales execution and performance.
* Advanced Excel and BI platform skills with working fluency in SQL; Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst certification preferred, along with a strong understanding of CRM processes.
* Strong initiative, intellectual curiosity and analytical capability, with a willingness to take ownership of complex problems and a resourceful approach to clearing obstacles.
* Exceptional organisational and time management skills, able to manage competing projects against tight deadlines.
* Collaborative team player with exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable working with senior management and cultivating relationships across cross\-functional teams and peers.

**About SOTI**


SOTI is the world's most trusted provider of mobile and IoT management solutions, with more than 17,000 enterprise customers and millions of devices managed worldwide. SOTI's innovative portfolio of solutions and services provide the tools organizations need to truly mobilize their operations and optimize their mobility investments. SOTI extends secure mobility management to provide a total, flexible solution for comprehensive management and security of all mobile devices and connected peripherals deployed in an organization.


At SOTI, we celebrate the uniqueness of our global teams and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are curious problem solvers who are committed to bringing the best mobile and IoT management solutions to market. We offer careers with \#EndlessPossibilities.


What are you waiting for? Apply today: soti.net/careers

**If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.**
